items.title: Mūl.17
items.text: चाणाख्यमूलकं चान्यच् छालेयं विष्णुगुप्तकम् स्थूलमूलं महाकन्दं कौटिल्यं मरुसम्भवम् शालामर्कटकं मिश्रं ज्ञेयं चैव नवाभिधम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.18
items.text: चाणाख्यमूलकं सोष्णं कटुकं रुच्यदीपनम् कफवातक्रिमीन्गुल्मं नाशयेद्ग्राहकं गुरु
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.19
items.text: गृञ्जनं शिखिमूलं च यवनेष्टं च वर्तुलम् ग्रन्थिमूलं शिखाकन्दं कन्दं डिण्डीरमोदकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.20
items.text: गृञ्जनं कटुकोष्णं च कफवातरुजापहम् रुच्यं च दीपनं हृद्यं दुर्गन्धं गुल्मनाशनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.21
items.text: पिण्डमूलं गजाण्डं च पिण्डकं पिण्डमूलकम् पिण्डमूलं कटूष्णं च गुल्मवातादिदोषनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.22
items.text: सोष्णं तीक्ष्णं च तिक्तं मधुरकटुरसं मूत्रदोषापहारि श्वासार्शःकासगुल्मक्षयनयनरुजानाभिशूलामयघ्नम् कण्ठ्यं बल्यं च रुच्यं मलविकृतिहरं मूलकं बालकं स्यात् उष्णं जीर्णं च शोषप्रदमुदितमिदं दाहपित्तास्रदायि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.23
items.text: आमं संग्राहि रुच्यं कफपवनहरं पक्वमेतत्कटूष्णं भुक्तेः प्राग्भक्षितं चेत्सपदि वितनुते पित्तदाहास्रकोपम् भुक्त्या सार्धं तु जग्धं हितकरबलकृद्वेशवारेण तच्चेत्पक्वं हृद्रोगशूलप्रशमनमुदितं शूलरुग्घारि मूलम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.24
items.text: गर्जरं पिङ्गमूलं च पीतकं च सुमूलकम् स्वादुमूलं सुपीतं च नारङ्गं पीतमूलकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.25
items.text: गर्जरं मधुरं रुच्यं किंचित्कटु कफापहमाध्मानक्रिमिशूलघ्नं दाहपित्ततृषापहम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.26
items.text: शिग्रुर्हरितशाकश्च शाकपत्त्रः सुपत्त्रकः उपदंशः क्षमादंशो ज्ञेयः कोमलपत्त्रकः बहुमूलो दंशमूलस्तीक्ष्णमूलो दशाह्वयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.27
items.text: शिग्रुश्च कटुतिक्तोष्णस्तीक्ष्णो वातकफापहः मुखजाड्यहरो रुच्यो दीपनो व्रणदोषनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.28
items.text: शोभाञ्जनो नीलशिग्रुस्तीक्ष्णगन्धो जनप्रियः मुखामोदः कृष्णशिग्रुश्चक्षुष्यो रुचिरञ्जनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.29
items.text: शोभाञ्जनस्तीक्ष्णकटुः स्वादूष्णः पिच्छिलस्तथा जन्तुवातार्तिशूलघ्नश्चक्षुष्यो रोचनः परः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.30
items.text: श्वेतशिग्रुः सुतीक्ष्णः स्यान्मुखभङ्गः सिताह्वयः सुमूलः श्वेतमरिचो रोचनो मधुशिग्रुकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.31
items.text: श्वेतशिग्रुः कटुस्तीक्ष्णः शोफानिलनिकृन्तनः अङ्गव्यथाहरो रुच्यो दीपनो मुखजाड्यनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.32
items.text: रक्तको रक्तशिग्रुः स्यान्मधुरो बहुलच्छदः सुगन्धकेसरः सिंहो मृगारिश्च प्रकीर्तितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.33
items.text: रक्तशिग्रुर्महावीर्यो मधुरश्च रसायनः शोफाध्मानसमीरार्तिपित्तश्लेष्मापसारकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.34
items.text: वंशो यवफलो वेणुः कर्मारस्तृणकेतुकः मस्करः शतपर्वा च कण्टालुः कण्टकी तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.35
items.text: महाबलो दृढग्रन्थिर्दृढपत्त्रो धनुद्रुमः धनुष्यो दृढकाण्डश्च विज्ञेयो बाणभूमितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.36
items.text: वंशौ त्वम्लौ कषायौ च किंचित्तिक्तौ च शीतलौ मूत्रकृच्छ्रप्रमेहार्शःपित्तदाहास्रनाशनौ
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.37
items.text: अन्यस्तु रन्ध्रवंशः स्यात्त्वक्सारः कीचकाह्वयः मस्करो वादनीयश्च सुषिराख्यः षडाह्वयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.38
items.text: विशेषो रन्ध्रवंशस्तु दीपनो ऽजीर्णनाशनः रुचिकृत्पाचनो हृद्यः शूलघ्नो गुल्मनाशनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.39
items.text: वंशाग्रं तु करीरो वंशाङ्कुरश्च यवफलाङ्कुरः तस्य ग्रन्थिस्तु परुः पर्व तथा काण्डसन्धिश्च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.40
items.text: करीरं कटुतिक्ताम्लं कषायं लघु शीतलम् पित्तास्रदाहकृच्छ्रघ्नं रुचिकृत्पर्व निर्गुणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.41
items.text: वेत्रो वेतो योगिदण्डः सुदण्डो मृदुपर्वकः वेत्रः पञ्चविधः शैत्यकषायो भूतपित्तहृत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.42
items.text: माकन्दी बहुमूला च मादनी गन्धमूलिका एका विशदमूली च श्यामला च तथापरा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.43
items.text: माकन्दी कटुका तिक्ता मधुरा दीपनी परा रुच्याल्पवातला पथ्या न वर्षासु हिताधिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.44
items.text: शोली वनहरिद्रा स्यात् वनारिष्टा च शोलिका शोलिका कटुगौल्या च रुच्या तिक्ता च दीपनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.45
items.text: शृङ्गाटकः शृङ्गरुहो जलवल्ली जलाश्रया शृङ्गकन्दः शृङ्गमूलो विषाणी सप्तनामकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.46
items.text: शृङ्गाटकः शोणितपित्तहारी लघुः सरो वृष्यतमो विशेषात्त्रिदोषतापश्रमशोफहारो रुचिप्रदो मेहनदार्ढ्यहेतुः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.47
items.text: भृङ्गाह्वा भ्रमरच्छल्ली भ्रमरा भृङ्गमूलिका भृङ्गच्छल्ली कटूष्णा स्यात्तिक्ता दीपनरोचनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.48
items.text: पेऊर्वनार्द्रका प्रोक्ता वनजारण्यजार्द्रका पेऊस्तु कटुकाम्ला च रुचिकृद्बल्यदीपनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.49
items.text: रसोनो लशुनो ऽरिष्टो म्लेच्छकन्दो महौषधम् भूतघ्नश्चोग्रगन्धश्च लशुनः शीतमर्दकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.50
items.text: रसोनो ऽम्लरसोनः स्यात् गुरूष्णः कफवातनुत् अरुचिक्रिमिहृद्रोगशोफघ्नश्च रसायनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.51
items.text: रसोन उष्णः कटुपिच्छिलश्च स्निग्धो गुरुः स्वादुरसो ऽतिबल्यः वृष्यश्च मेधास्वरवर्णचक्षुष्यास्थिसंधर्भानकरः सुतीक्ष्णः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.52
items.text: रसोनो ऽन्यो महाकन्दो गृजनो दीर्घपत्त्रकः पृथुपत्त्रः स्थूलकन्दो यवनेष्टो बले हितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.53
items.text: गृञ्जनस्य मधुरं कटु कन्दं नालमप्युपदिशन्ति कषायम् पत्त्रसंचयमुशन्ति च तिक्तं सूरयो लवणमस्थि वदन्ति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.54
items.text: हृद्रोगजीर्णज्वरकुक्षिशूलविबन्धगुल्मारुचिकृच्छ्रशोफान्दुर्नामकुष्ठानिलसादजन्तुकफामयान्हन्ति महारसोनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.55
items.text: पलाण्डुस्तीक्ष्णकन्दश्च उल्ली च मुखदूषणः शूद्रप्रियः क्रिमिघ्नश्च दीपनो मुखगन्धकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.56
items.text: बहुपत्त्रो विश्वगन्धो रोचनो रुद्रसंज्ञकः श्वेतकन्दश्च तत्रैको हारिद्रो ऽन्य इति द्विधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.57
items.text: पलाण्डुः कटुको बल्यः कफपित्तहरो गुरुः वृष्यश्च रोचनः स्निग्धो वान्तिदोषविनाशनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.58
items.text: अन्यो राजपलाण्डुः स्यात् यवनेष्टो नृपाह्वयः राजप्रियो महाकन्दो दीर्घपत्त्रश्च रोचकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.59
items.text: नृपेष्टो नृपकन्दश्च महाकन्दो नृपप्रियः रक्तकन्दश्च राजेष्टो नामान्यत्र त्रयोदश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.60
items.text: पलाण्डुर्नृपपूर्वः स्यात् शिशिरः पित्तनाशनः कफहृद्दीपनश्चैव बहुनिद्राकरस्तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.61
items.text: वक्ष्यते नृपपलाण्डुलक्षणं क्षारतीक्ष्णमधुरो रुचिप्रदः कण्ठशोषशमनो ऽतिदीपनः श्लेष्मपित्तशमनो ऽतिबृंहणः

items.title: Mūl.62

items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: चण्डालकन्दो मधुरः कफपित्तास्रदोषजित् विषभूतादिदोषघ्नो विज्ञेयश्च रसायनः

items.title: Mūl.122

items.title: Mūl.157

items.title: Mūl.199

items.title: Mūl.200

items.title: Mūl.202

items.title: Mūl.203
items.text: कर्कटी मधुरा शीता त्वक्तिक्ता कफपित्तजित् रक्तदोषकरा पक्वा मूत्ररोधार्तिनाशनी

items.title: Mūl.204

items.title: Mūl.205
items.text: त्रपुसी पीतपुष्पी कण्टालुस्त्रपुसकर्कटी बहुफला कोशफला सा तुन्दिलफला मुनिः

items.title: Mūl.206

items.title: Mūl.207
items.text: एर्वारुः कर्कटी प्रोक्ता व्यालपत्त्रा च लोमशा स्थूला तोयफला चैव हस्तिदन्तफला मुनिः

items.title: Mūl.208
items.text: एर्वारुकं पित्तहरं सुशीतलं मूत्रामयघ्नं मधुरं रुचिप्रदम् संतापमूर्छापहरं सुतृप्तिदं वातप्रकोपाय घनं तु सेवितम्

items.title: Mūl.209
items.text: अथ वालुकी बहुफला स्निग्धफला क्षेत्रकर्कटी क्षेत्ररुहा मधुरफला शारदिका क्षुद्रेर्वारुश्च पीतपुष्पिका

items.title: Mūl.210
items.text: वालुकी मधुरा शीताध्मानहृच्च श्रमापहा पित्तास्रशमनी रुच्या कुरुते कासपीनसौ

items.title: Mūl.211
items.text: वालुकानि च सर्वाणि दुर्जराणि गुरूणि च मन्दानलं प्रकुर्वन्ति वातरक्तहराणि च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.212
items.text: स्याद्वालुकी शरदि वर्षजदोषकर्त्री हेमन्तजा तु खलु पित्तहरा च रुच्या क्षिप्रं करोति खलु पीनसमर्धपक्वा पक्वा त्वतीव मधुरा कफकारिणी च

items.title: Mūl.213
items.text: चीनकर्कटिका ज्ञेया बीजकर्कटिका तथा सुदीर्घा राजिलफला बाणैः कुलककर्कटी

items.title: Mūl.214
items.text: चीनकर्कटिका रुच्या शिशिरा पित्तनाशनी मधुरा तृप्तिदा हृद्या दाहशोषापहारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.215
items.text: स्यात् चिर्भिटा सुचित्रा चित्रफला क्षेत्रचिर्भिटा पाण्डुफला पथ्या च रोचनफला चिर्भिटिका कर्कटिका ग्रहसंख्या

items.title: Mūl.216
items.text: बाल्ये तिक्ता चिर्भिटा किंचिदम्ला गौल्योपेता दीपनी सा च पाके शुष्का रूक्षा श्लेष्मवातारुचिघ्नी जाड्यघ्नी सा रोचनी दीपनी च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.217
items.text: शशाण्डुली बहुफला तण्डुली क्षेत्रसम्भवा क्षुद्राम्ला लोमशफला धूम्रवृत्तफला च सा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.218
items.text: शशाण्डुली तिक्तकटुश्च कोमला कट्वम्लयुक्ता जरठा कफापहा पाके तु साम्ला मधुरा विदाहकृत्कफश्च शुष्का रुचिकृच्च दीपनी

items.title: Mūl.219
items.text: कुडुहुञ्ची श्रीफलिका प्रतिपत्त्रफला च सा शुभ्रवी कारवी चैव प्रोक्ता बहुफला तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.220
items.text: क्षुद्रकारलिका प्रोक्ता ज्ञेया कन्दलता तथा क्षुद्रादिकारवल्ली च प्रोक्ता सा च नवाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.221
items.text: कुडुहुञ्ची कटुरुष्णा तिक्ता रुचिकारिणी च दीपनदा रक्तानिलदोषकरी पथ्यापि च सा फले प्रोक्ता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Mūl.222

items.title: Mūl.223
items.text: इति मूलकन्दफलपत्त्रसुन्दरक्रमनामतद्गुणनिरूपणोल्वणमवलोक्य वर्गमिममामयोचितामगदप्रयुक्तिमवबुध्यतां बुधः

items.title: Mūl.224

items.title: Mūl.225
items.text: लब्धान्योन्यसहायवैद्यककुलाच् छङ्काकलङ्कापनुत् दस्रैक्यावतरो ऽयमित्यविरतं सन्तः प्रशंसन्ति यम् तस्य श्रीनृहरेः कृताववसितो यो मलकादिर्महान्वर्गो ऽसावभिधानकोशपरिषच्चूडामणौ सप्तमः

items.title: Parp.1
items.text: पर्पटो जीवकश्चैवर्षभकः श्रावणी द्विधा मेदाद्वयमृद्धिवृद्धी धूम्रपत्त्रा प्रसारणी

items.title: Parp.3

items.title: Parp.4

items.title: Parp.5

items.title: Parp.7

items.title: Parp.10

items.title: Parp.11
items.text: जीवको जीवनो जीव्यः शृङ्गाह्वः प्राणदः प्रियः चिरजीवी च मधुरो मङ्गल्यः कूर्चशीर्षकः

items.title: Parp.12

items.title: Parp.13
items.text: जीवको मधुरः शीतो रक्तपित्तानिलार्तिजित्क्षयदाहज्वरान्हन्ति शुक्रश्लेष्मविवर्धनः

items.title: Parp.14
items.text: ऋषभो गोपतिर्धीरो विषाणी धूर्द्धरो वृषः ककुद्मान् पुङ्गवो वोढा शृङ्गी धुर्यश्च भूपतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.15
items.text: कामी ऋक्षप्रियश्चोक्षा लाङ्गुली गौश्च बन्धुरः गोरक्षो वनवासी च ज्ञेयो विंशतिनामकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.16
items.text: ऋषभो मधुरः शीतः पित्तरक्तविरेकनुत् शुक्रश्लेष्मकरो दाहक्षयज्वरहरश्च सः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.17
items.text: श्रावणी स्यान्मुण्डितिका भिक्षुः श्रवणशीर्षिका श्रवणा च प्रव्रजिता परिव्राजी तपोधना
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.18

items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.19
items.text: महाश्रावणिकान्या सा महामुण्डी च लोचनी कदम्बपुष्पी विकचा क्रोडचूडा पलङ्कषा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.20
items.text: नदीकदम्बो मुण्डाख्या महामुण्डनिका च सा छिन्ना ग्रन्थिनिका माता स्थविरा लोभनी तथा भूकदम्बो ऽलम्बुषा स्यादिति सप्तदशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.21
items.text: महामुण्ड्युष्णतिक्ता च ईषद्गौल्या मरुच्छिदा स्वरकृद्रोचनी चैव मेहहृच्च रसायनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.22

items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.23
items.text: मेदःसारा स्नेहवती मेदिनी मधुरा वरा स्निग्धा मेदोद्रवा साध्वी शल्यदा बहुरन्ध्रिका ऊनविंशत्याह्वया सा मता पूरुषदन्तिका

items.title: Parp.24
items.text: मेदा तु मधुरा शीता पित्तदाहार्तिकासनुत् राजयक्ष्मज्वरहरा वातदोषकरी च सा

items.title: Parp.25
items.text: महामेदा वसुच्छिद्रा जीवनी पांशुरागिणी देवेष्टा सुरमेदा च दिव्या देवमणिस्तथा

items.title: Parp.26
items.text: देवगन्धा महाच्छिद्रा ऋक्षार्हा रुद्रसंमिता महामेदाभिधः कन्दो लताजातः सुपाण्डुरः मेदापि शुक्लकन्दः स्यान्मेदोधातुमिव स्रवेत्

items.title: Parp.27
items.text: महामेदा हिमा रुच्या कफशुक्रप्रवृद्धिकृत् हन्ति दाहास्रपित्तानि क्षयवातज्वरं च सा

items.title: Parp.28
items.text: ऋद्धिः सिद्धिः प्राणदा जीवदात्री सिद्धा योग्या चेतनीया रथाङ्गी मङ्गल्या स्याल्लोककान्ता यशस्या जीवश्रेष्ठा द्वादशाह्वा क्रमेण

items.title: Parp.29
items.text: वृद्धिस्तुष्टिः पुष्टिदा वृद्धिदात्री मङ्गल्या श्रीः सम्पदाशीर्जनेष्टा लक्ष्मीर्भूतिर्मुत्सुखं जीवभद्रा स्यादित्येषा लोकसंज्ञा क्रमेण

items.title: Parp.30
items.text: ऋद्धिर्वृद्धिश्च कन्दौ द्वौ भवतः कोशयामले श्वेतरोमान्वितः कन्दो लताजातः सरन्ध्रकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.31
items.text: तूलग्रन्थिसमा ऋद्धिर्वामावर्तफला च सा वृद्धिस्तु दक्षिणावर्तफला प्रोक्ता महर्षिभिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.32
items.text: ऋद्धिर्वृद्धिश्च मधुरा सुस्निग्धा तिक्तशीतला रुचिमेधाकरी श्लेष्मक्रिमिकुष्ठहरा परा

items.title: Parp.33
items.text: प्रयोगेष्वनयोरेकं यथालाभं प्रयोजयेत् यत्र द्वयानुसृष्टिः स्याद्द्वयमप्यत्र योजयेत्

items.title: Parp.34
items.text: धूम्रपत्त्रा तु धूम्राह्वा सुलभा तु स्वयम्भुवा गृध्रपत्त्रा च गृध्राणी क्रिमिघ्नी स्त्रीमलापहा

items.title: Parp.35
items.text: धूम्रपत्त्रा रसे तिक्ता शोफघ्नी क्रिमिनाशिनी उष्णा कासहरा चैव रुच्या दीपनकारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.36
items.text: प्रसारणी सुप्रसरा सारणी सरणी सरा चारुपर्णी राजबला भद्रपर्णी प्रतानिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.37
items.text: प्रबला राजपर्णी च बल्या भद्रबला तथा चन्द्रवल्ली प्रभद्रा च ज्ञेया पञ्चदशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.38
items.text: प्रसारणी गुरूष्णा च तिक्ता वातविनाशिनी अर्शःश्वयथुहन्त्री च मलविष्टम्भहारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.39
items.text: पाषाणभेदको ऽश्मघ्नः शिलाभेदो ऽश्मभेदकः श्वेता चोपलभेदी च नगजिच् छिलिगर्भजा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.40
items.text: पाषाणभेदो मधुरस्तिक्तो मेहविनाशनः तृड्दाहमूत्रकृच्छ्रघ्नः शीतलश्चाश्मरीहरः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.41
items.text: अन्या तु वटपत्त्री स्यादन्या चैरावती च सा गोधावतीरावती च श्यामा खट्वाङ्गनामिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.42
items.text: वटपत्त्री हिमा गौल्या मेहकृच्छ्रविनाशिनी बलदा व्रणहन्त्री च किंचिद्दीपनकारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.43
items.text: अन्या श्वेता शिलावल्का शिलाजा शैलवल्कला वल्कला शैलगर्भाह्वा शिलात्वक्सप्तनामिका

items.title: Parp.44
items.text: शिलावल्कं हिमं स्वादु मेहकृच्छ्रविनाशनम् मूत्ररोधाश्मरीशूलक्षयपित्तापहारकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.45
items.text: क्षुद्रपाषाणभेदान्या चतुष्पत्त्री च पार्वती नागभूरश्मकेतुश्च गिरिभूः कन्दरोद्भवा

items.title: Parp.46
items.text: शैलोद्भवा च गिरिजा नगजा च दशाह्वया क्षुद्रपाषाणभेदा तु व्रणकृच्छ्राश्मरीहरा

items.title: Parp.47
items.text: गृहकन्या कुमारी च कन्यका दीर्घपत्त्रिका स्थलेरुहा मृदुः कन्या बहुपत्त्रामराजरा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.48
items.text: कण्टकप्रावृता वीरा भृङ्गेष्टा विपुलस्रवा ब्रह्मघ्नी तरुणी रामा कपिला चाम्बुधिस्रवा सुकण्टका स्थूलदलेत्येकविंशतिनामका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.49
items.text: गृहकन्या हिमा तिक्ता मदगन्धिः कफापहा पित्तकासविषश्वासकुष्ठघ्नी च रसायनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.50
items.text: बर्हिचूडा तु शिखिनी शिखालुः सुशिखा शिखा शिखाबला केकिशिखा मयूराद्यभिधा शिखा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.51
items.text: बर्हिचूडा रसे स्वादुर्मूत्रकृच्छ्रविनाशिनी बालग्रहादिदोषघ्नी वश्यकर्मणि शस्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.52
items.text: क्षीरिणी काञ्चनक्षीरी कर्षणी कटुपर्णिका तिक्तदुग्धा हैमवती हिमदुग्धा हिमावती
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.53
items.text: हिमाद्रिजा पीतदुग्धा यवचिञ्चा हिमोद्भवा हैमी च हिमजा चेति चतुरेकगुणाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.54
items.text: क्षीरिणी कटुतिक्ता च रेचनी शोफतापनुत्क्रिमिदोषकफघ्नी च पित्तज्वरहरा च सा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.55
items.text: स्वर्णक्षीरी स्वर्णदुग्धा स्वर्णाह्वा रुक्मिणी तथा सुवर्णा हेमदुग्धी च हेमक्षीरी च काञ्चनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.56
items.text: स्वर्णक्षीरी हिमा तिक्ता क्रिमिपित्तकफापहा मूत्रकृच्छ्राश्मरीशोफदाहज्वरहरा परा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.57
items.text: त्रायमाणा कृतत्राणा त्रायन्ती त्रायमाणिका बलभद्रा सुकामा च वार्षिकी गिरिजानुजा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.58
items.text: मङ्गल्याह्वा देवबला पालनी भयनाशिनी अवनी रक्षणी त्राणा विज्ञेया षोडशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.59
items.text: त्रायन्ती शीतमधुरा गुल्मज्वरकफास्रनुत् भ्रमतृष्णाक्षयग्लानिविषच्छर्दिविनाशिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.60
items.text: स्याद्रुदन्ती स्रवत्तोया संजीवन्यमृतस्रवा रोमाञ्चिका महामांसी चणपत्त्री सुधास्रवा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.61
items.text: रुदन्ती कटुतिक्तोष्णा क्षयक्रिमिविनाशिनी रक्तपित्तकफश्वासमेहहारी रसायनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.62
items.text: चणपत्त्रसमं पत्त्रं क्षुपं चैव तथाम्लकम् शिशिरे जलबिन्दूनां स्रवन्तीति रुदन्तिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.63
items.text: ब्राह्मी सरस्वती सौम्या सुरश्रेष्ठा सुवर्चला कपोतवेगा वैधात्री दिव्यतेजा महौषधी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.64
items.text: स्वायम्भुवी सोमलता सुरेज्या ब्रह्मकन्यका मण्डूकमाता मत्स्याक्षी मण्डूकी सुरसा तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.65
items.text: मेध्या वीरा भारती च वरा च परमेष्ठिनी दिव्या च शारदी चेति चतुर्विंशतिनामका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.66
items.text: ब्राह्मी हिमा कषाया च तिक्ता वातास्रपित्तजित् बुद्धिं प्रज्ञां च मेधां च कुर्यादायुष्यवर्धनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.67
items.text: ब्राह्मी तु क्षुद्रपत्त्रान्या लघुब्राह्मी जलोद्भवा ब्राह्मी तिक्तरसोष्णा च सरा वातामशोफजित्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.68
items.text: वन्दाकः पादपरुहा शिखरी तरुरोहिणी वृक्षादनी वृक्षरुहा कामवृक्षश्च शेखरी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.69
items.text: केशरूपा तरुरुहा तरुस्था गन्धमेदिनी कामिनी तरुरुट्श्यामा द्रुपदी षोडशाभिधाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.70
items.text: वन्दाकस्तिक्तशिशिरः कफपित्तश्रमापहः वश्यादिसिद्धिदो वृष्यः कषायश्च रसायनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.71
items.text: कुलत्था दृक्प्रसादा च ज्ञेयारण्यकुलत्थिका कुलाली लोचनहिता चक्षुष्या कुम्भकारिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.72
items.text: कुलत्थिका कटुस्तिक्ता स्यादर्शःशूलनाशनी विबन्धाध्मानशमनी चक्षुष्या व्रणरोपणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.73
items.text: तण्डुलीयस्तु भण्डीरस्तण्डुली तण्डुलीयकः ग्रन्थिलो बहुवीर्यश्च मेघनादो घनस्वनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.74
items.text: सुशाकः पथ्यशाकश्च स्फूर्जथुः स्वनिताह्वयः वीरस्तण्डुलनामा च पर्यायाश्च चतुर्दश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.75
items.text: तण्डुलीयस्तु शिशिरो मधुरो विषनाशनः रुचिकृद्दीपनः पथ्यः पित्तदाहभ्रमापहः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.76
items.text: चिविल्लिका रक्तदला खरच्छदा स्यात्क्षुद्रघोली मधुमालपत्त्रिका चिविल्लिका चैव कटुः कषायिका ज्वरे ऽतिसारे च हिता रसायनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.77
items.text: हस्तिशुण्डी महाशुण्डी शुण्डी घूसरपत्त्रिका हस्तिशुण्डी कटूष्णा स्यात्संनिपातज्वरापहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.78
items.text: कुटुम्बिनी पयस्या च क्षीरिणी जलकामुका वक्रशल्या दुराधर्षा क्रूरकर्मा झिरिण्टिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.79
items.text: शीता प्रहरजाया च शीतला च जलेरुहा विख्याता किल विद्वद्भिरेषा द्वादशनामभिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.80
items.text: कुटुम्बिनी तु मधुरा ग्राहिणी कफपित्तनुत् व्रणास्रदोषकण्डूतिनाशनी सा रसायनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.81
items.text: स्थलपद्मी तु पद्माह्वा चारटी पद्मचारिणी सुगन्धमूलाम्बुरुहा लक्ष्मीश्रेष्ठा सुपुष्करा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.82
items.text: रम्या पद्मवती चातिचरा स्थूलरुहा स्मृता ज्ञेया पुष्करिणी चैव पुष्कराद्या च पर्णिका पुष्करादियुता नाडी प्रोक्ता पञ्चदशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.83
items.text: स्थलादिपद्मिनी गौल्या तिक्ता शीता च वान्तिनुत् रक्तपित्तहरा मेहभूतातीसारनाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.84
items.text: जम्बूर्जाम्बवती वृत्ता वृत्तपुष्पा च जाम्बवी मदघ्नी नागदमनी दुर्धर्षा दुःसहा नव
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.85
items.text: ज्ञेया जम्बूस्त्रिदोषघ्नी तीक्ष्णोष्णा कटुतिक्तका उदराध्मानदोषघ्नी कोष्ठशोधनकारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.86
items.text: नागदन्ती श्वेतघण्टा मधुपुष्पा विशोधनी नागस्फोता विशालाक्षी नागच्छत्रा विचक्षणा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.87
items.text: सर्पपुष्पी शुक्लपुष्पी स्वादुका शीतदन्तिका सितपुष्पी सर्पदन्ती नागिनी बाणभूमिता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.88
items.text: नागदन्ती कटुस्तिक्ता रूक्षा वातकफापहा मेधाकृद्विषदोषघ्नी पाचनी शुभदायिनी गुल्मशूलोदरव्याधिकण्ठदोषनिकृन्तनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.89
items.text: विष्णुक्रान्ता हरिक्रान्ता नीलपुष्पापराजिता नीलक्रान्ता सतीना च विक्रान्ता छर्दिका च सा विष्णुक्रान्ता कटुस्तिक्ता कफवातामयापहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.90
items.text: कुणञ्जरः कुणञ्जी च कुणञ्जो ऽरण्यवास्तुकः कुणञ्जो मधुरो रुच्यो दीपनः पाचनो हितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.91
items.text: भूम्यामली तमाली च ताली चैव तमालिका उच्चटा दृढपादी च वितुन्ना च वितुन्निका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.92
items.text: भूधात्री चारुटा वृष्या विषघ्नी बहुपत्रिका बहुवीर्याहिभयदा विश्वपर्णी हिमालया जटा वीरा च नाम्नां सा भवेदेकोनविंशतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.93
items.text: भूधात्री तु कषायाम्ला पित्तमेहविनाशनी शिशिरा मूत्ररोगार्तिशमनी दाहनाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.94
items.text: गोरक्षी सर्पदण्डी च दीर्घदण्डी सुदण्डिका चित्रला गन्धबहुला गोपाली पञ्चपर्णिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.95
items.text: गोरक्षी मधुरा तिक्ता शिशिरा दाहपित्तनुत् विस्फोटवान्त्यतीसारज्वरदोषविनाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.96
items.text: गोलोमिका तु गोधूमी गोजा क्रोष्टुकपुच्छिका गोसम्भवा प्रस्तरिणी विज्ञेयेति षडाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.97
items.text: गोलोमिका कटुस्तिक्ता त्रिदोषशमनी हिमा मूलरोगास्रदोषघ्नी ग्राहिणी दीपनी च सा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.98
items.text: दुग्धफेनी पयःफेनी फेनदुग्धा पयस्विनी लूतारिर्व्रणकेतुश्च गोजापर्णी च सप्तधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.99
items.text: दुग्धफेनी कटुस्तिक्ता शिशिरा विषनाशिनी व्रणापसारिणी रुच्या युक्त्या चैव रसायनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.100
items.text: क्षुद्राम्लिका तु चाङ्गेरी चुक्राह्वा चुक्रिका च सा लोणाम्ला च चतुष्पर्णी लोणा लोडाम्लपत्रिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.101
items.text: अम्बष्ठाम्लवती चैव अम्ला दन्तशठा मता शस्त्राङ्गा चाम्लपत्त्री च ज्ञेया पञ्चदशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.102
items.text: क्षुद्राम्ली च रसे साम्ला सोष्णा सा वह्निवर्धनी रुचिकृद्ग्रहणीदोषदुर्नामघ्नी कफापहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.103
items.text: रक्तपादी शमीपत्त्रा स्पृक्का खदिरपत्रिका सङ्कोचनी समङ्गा च नमस्कारी प्रसारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.104
items.text: लज्जालुः सप्तपर्णी स्यात्खदिरी गण्डमालिका लज्जा च लज्जिका चैव स्पर्शलज्जास्ररोधनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.105
items.text: रक्तमूला ताम्रमूला स्वगुप्ताञ्जलिकारिका नाम्नां विंशतिरित्युक्ता लज्जायास्तु भिषग्वरैः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.106
items.text: रक्तपादी कटुः शीता पित्तातीसारनाशनी शोफदाहश्रमश्वासव्रणकुष्ठकफास्रनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.107
items.text: लज्जालुर्वैपरीत्यान्या अल्पक्षुपबृहद्दला वैपरीत्या तु लज्जालुर्ह्यभिधाने प्रयोजयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.108
items.text: लज्जालुर्वैपरीत्याह्वा कटुरुष्णा कफामनुत् रसो नियामको ऽत्यन्तनानाविज्ञानकारकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.109
items.text: रक्तपाद्यपरा प्रोक्ता त्रिपदा हंसपादिका घृतमण्डलिका ज्ञेया विश्वग्रन्थिस्त्रिपादिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.110
items.text: विपादी कीटमारी च हेमपादी मधुस्रवा कर्णाटी ताम्रपत्त्री च विक्रान्ता सुवहा तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.111
items.text: ब्रह्मादनी पदाङ्गी च शीताङ्गी सुतपादुका संचारिणी च पदिका प्रह्लादी कीलपादिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.112
items.text: गोधापदी च हंसाङ्घ्रिर्धार्त्तराष्ट्रपदी तथा हंसपादी च विज्ञेया नाम्ना चैषा शराक्षिधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.113
items.text: हंसपादी कटूष्णा स्यात् विषभूतविनाशिनी भ्रान्त्यपस्मारदोषघ्नी विज्ञेया च रसायनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.114
items.text: काथरा हयपर्यायैः काथरान्तैः प्रकीर्तिता अश्वकाथरिका तिक्ता वातघ्नी दीपनी परा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.115
items.text: पुनर्नवा विशाखश्च कठिल्लः शशिवाटिका पृथ्वी च सितवर्षाभूर्दीर्घपत्रः कठिल्लकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.116
items.text: श्वेता पुनर्नवा सोष्णा तिक्ता कफविषापहा कासहृद्रोगशूलास्रपाण्डुशोफानिलार्तिनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.117
items.text: पुनर्नवान्या रक्ताख्या क्रूरा मण्डलपत्त्रिका रक्तकाण्डा वर्षकेतुर्लोहिता रक्तपत्त्रिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.118
items.text: वैशाखी रक्तवर्षाभूः शोफघ्नी रक्तपुष्पिका विकस्वरा विषघ्नी च प्रावृषेण्या च सारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.119
items.text: वर्षाभवः शोणपत्रः शोणः संमीलितद्रुमः पुनर्नवो नवो नव्यः स्याद्द्वाविंशतिसंज्ञया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.120
items.text: रक्ता पुनर्नवा तिक्ता सारिणी शोफनाशिनी दरदोषघ्नी पाण्डुपित्तप्रमर्दिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.121
items.text: नीला पुनर्नवा नीला श्यामा नीलपुनर्नवा कृष्णाख्या नीलवर्षाभूर्नीलिनी स्वाभिधान्विता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.122
items.text: नीला पुनर्नवा तिक्ता कटूष्णा च रसायनी हृद्रोगपाण्डुश्वयथुश्वासवातकफापहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.123
items.text: वसुको ऽथ वसुः शैवो वसो ऽथ शिवमल्लिका पाशुपतः शिवमतः सुरेष्टः शिवशेखरः सितो रक्तो द्विधा प्रोक्तो ज्ञेयः स च नवाभिधः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.124
items.text: वसुकौ कटुतिक्तोष्णौ पाके शीतौ च दीपनौ अजीर्णवातगुल्मघ्नौ श्वेतश्चैव रसायनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.125
items.text: सर्पिणी भुजगी भोगी कुण्डली पन्नगी फणी षडभिधा सर्पिणी स्याद्विषघ्नी कुचवर्धनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.126
items.text: वृश्चिका नखपर्णी च पिच्छिलाप्यलिपत्त्रिका वृश्चिका पिच्छलाम्ला स्यादन्त्रवृद्ध्यादिदोषनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.127
items.text: ब्राह्मी वयस्या मत्स्याक्षी मीनाक्षी सोमवल्लरी मत्स्याक्षी शिशिरा रुच्या व्रणदोषक्षयापहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.128
items.text: गुण्डाला तु जलोद्भूता गुच्छबुध्ना जलाशया गुण्डाला कटुतिक्तोष्णा शोफव्रणविनाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.129
items.text: भूपाटली च कुम्भी च भूताली रक्तपुष्पिका भूपाटली कटूष्णा च पारदे सुप्रयोजिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.130
items.text: पाटली पाण्डुरफली धूसरा वृत्तबीजका भूरिफली तथा पाण्डुफली स्यात् षड्विधाभिधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.131
items.text: शिशिरा पाण्डुरफली गौल्या कृच्छ्रार्तिदोषहा बल्या पित्तहरा वृष्या मूत्राघातनिवारणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.132
items.text: श्वेता तु छुरिकापत्त्री पर्वमूलाप्यविप्रिया श्वेतातिमधुरा शीता स्तन्यदा रुचिकृत्परा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.133
items.text: ब्रह्मदण्ड्यजलादण्डी कण्टपत्त्रफला च सा ब्रह्मदण्डी कटूष्णा स्यात्कफशोफानिलापहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.134
items.text: द्रवन्ती शाम्बरी चित्रा न्यग्रोधी शतमूलिका प्रत्यक्श्रेणी वृषा चण्डा पत्त्रश्रेण्याखुकर्णिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.135
items.text: मूषकाह्वादिका कर्णी प्रतिपर्णीशिफा सा सहस्रमूली विक्रान्ता ज्ञेया स्याच्चतुरेकधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.136
items.text: द्रवन्ती मधुरा शीता रसबन्धकरी परा ज्वरघ्नी क्रिमिहा शूलशमनी च रसायनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.137
items.text: द्रोणपुष्पी दीर्घपत्त्रा कुम्भयोनिः कुतुम्बिका चित्राक्षुपः कुतुम्बा च सुपुष्पा चित्रपत्त्रिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.138
items.text: द्रोणपुष्पी कटुः सोष्णा रुच्या वातकफापहा अग्निमान्द्यहरा चैव पथ्या वातापहारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.139
items.text: अन्या चैव महाद्रोणा कुरुम्बा देवपूर्वका दिव्यपुष्पा महाद्रोणी देवीकाण्डा षडाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.140
items.text: देवद्रोणी कटुस्तिक्ता मेध्या वातार्तिभूतनुत्कफमान्द्यापहा चैव युक्त्या पारदशोधने
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.141
items.text: झण्डूः स्यात्स्थूलपुष्पा तु झण्डूको झेण्डुकस्तथा झण्डूः कटुकषायः स्यात् ज्वरभूतग्रहापहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.142
items.text: गोरक्षदुग्धी गोरक्षी ताम्रदुग्धी रसायनी बहुपत्त्रा मृताजीवी मृतसंजीवनी मुनिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.143
items.text: गोरक्षदुग्धी मधुरा वृष्या सा ग्राहिणी हिमा सर्ववश्यकरी चैव रसे सिद्धिगुणप्रदा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.144
items.text: इत्थं वितत्य विशदीक्रियमाणनानाक्षुद्रक्षुपाह्वयगुणप्रगुणापवर्गम् वर्गं विधाय मुखमण्डनमेनमुच्चैरुच्चाटनाय च रुजां प्रभुरस्तु वैद्यः क्षुधं रान्ति जनस्योच्चैस्तस्मात्क्षुद्राः प्रकीर्तिताः तेषां क्षुपाणां वर्गो ऽयमादाने धातुरुच्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Parp.145
items.text: धत्ते नित्यसमाधिसंस्तववशात्प्रीत्यार्चितेशार्पितां स्वात्मीयामृतहस्ततां किल सदा यः सर्वसंजीवनीम् वर्गस्तस्य कृतौ नृसिंहकृतिनो यः पर्पटादिमहानेष प्राञ्चति नामकाण्डपरिषच्चूडामणौ पञ्चमः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.1
items.text: चतुर्धा पिप्पली प्रोक्ता तन्मूलं नागरं तथा आर्द्रकं मरिचद्वन्द्वं धान्यकं च यवानिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.2
items.text: चव्यं च चित्रकद्वन्द्वं विडङ्गं च वचाद्वयम् कुलञ्जो जीरकाः पञ्च मेथिका हिङ्गुपत्रिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.3
items.text: हिङ्गुद्वयं चाग्निजारौ रास्ने एलाद्वयं शिवम् सौवर्चलं च काचाह्वं विडं च गडनामकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.4
items.text: सामुद्रं द्रौणिकं चान्यदौषरं रोमकं तथा नवधा लवणं प्रोक्तमजमोदा च रेणुका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.5
items.text: बोलं कर्चूरकः पाठा वृक्षाम्लश्चाम्लवेतसम् कटुकातिविषा मुस्ताद्वयं यष्टीमधुद्वयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.6
items.text: भार्गी पुष्करमूलं च शृङ्ग्यथो दन्तिकाद्वयम् जैपालश्च त्रिवृद्द्वेधा त्वक्पत्रं नागकेशरम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.7
items.text: तवक्षीरं च तालीसपत्राख्यं वंशरोचना मञ्जिष्ठा च चतुर्धा स्याद्धरिद्रे च द्विधा मते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.8
items.text: लाक्षा चालक्तको लोध्रो धातक्यब्धिफलं तथा निर्विषाथ विषद्वन्द्वं द्विधा चाम्लहरिद्रका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.9
items.text: अब्धिफेनमफेनं च टङ्कणौ साकुरुण्डकम् हिमावली हस्तिमदः स्वर्जिको लोणकं तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.10
items.text: वज्रको यवजश्चाथ सर्वक्षारो ऽथ मायिका औषधान्यभिधीयन्ते षडङ्गमितसंख्यया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.11
items.text: पिप्पली कृकरा शौण्डी चपला मागधी कणा कटुबीजा च कोरङ्गी वैदेही तिक्ततण्डुला
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.12
items.text: श्यामा दन्तफला कृष्णा कोला च मगधोद्भवा उषणा चोपकुल्या च स्मृत्याह्वा तीक्ष्णतण्डुला
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.13
items.text: पिप्पली ज्वरहा वृष्या स्निग्धोष्णा कटुतिक्तका दीपनी मारुतश्वासकासश्लेष्मक्षयापहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.14
items.text: गजोषणा चव्यफला चव्यजा गजपिप्पली श्रेयसी छिद्रवैदेही दीर्घग्रन्थिश्च तैजसी वर्तुली स्थूलवैदेही ज्ञेया चेति दशाभिधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.15
items.text: गजोषणा कटूष्णा च रूक्षा मलविशोषणी बलासवातहन्त्री च स्तन्यवर्णविवर्धिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.16
items.text: सैंहली सर्पदण्डा च सर्पाङ्गी ब्रह्मभूमिजा पार्वती शैलजा ताम्रा लम्बबीजा तथोत्कटा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.17
items.text: अद्रिजा सिंहलस्था च लम्बदन्ता च जीवला जीवाली जीवनेत्रा च कुरवी षोडशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.18
items.text: सैंहली कटुरुष्णा च जन्तुघ्नी दीपनी परा कफश्वाससमीरार्तिशमनी कोष्ठशोधनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.19
items.text: वनादिपिप्पल्यभिधानयुक्तं सूक्ष्मादिपिप्पल्यभिधानमेतत्क्षुद्रादिपिप्पल्यभिधानयोग्यं वनाभिधापूर्वकणाभिधानम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.20
items.text: वनपिप्पलिका चोष्णा तीक्ष्णा रुच्या च दीपनी आमा भवेद्गुणाढ्या तु शुष्का स्वल्पगुणा स्मृता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.21
items.text: ग्रन्थिकं पिप्पलीमूलं मूलं तु चविकाशिरः कोलमूलं कटुग्रन्थि कटुमूलं कटूषणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.22
items.text: सर्वग्रन्थि च पत्त्राढ्यं विरूपं शोणसम्भवम् सुग्रन्थि ग्रन्थिलं चैव पर्यायाः स्युश्चतुर्दश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.23
items.text: कटूष्णं पिप्पलीमूलं श्लेष्मक्रिमिविनाशनम् दीपनं वातरोगघ्नं रोचनं पित्तकोपनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.24
items.text: शुण्ठी महौषधं विश्वं नागरं विश्वभेषजम् विश्वौषधं कटुग्रन्थि कटुभद्रं कटूषणम्

items.title: Pipp.25
items.text: सौपर्णं शृङ्गवेरं च कफारिश्चार्द्रकं स्मृतम् शोषणं नागराह्वं च विज्ञेयं षोडशाह्वयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.26
items.text: शुण्ठी कटूष्णा स्निग्धा च कफशोफानिलापहा शूलबन्धोदराध्मानश्वासश्लीपदहारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.27
items.text: आर्द्रकं गुल्ममूलं च मूलजं कन्दलं वरम् शृङ्गवेरं महीजं च सैकतेष्टमनूपजम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.28
items.text: अपाकशाकं चार्द्राख्यं राहुच्छत्त्रं सुशाककम् शार्ङ्गं स्यादार्द्रशाकं च सच्छाकमृतुभूह्वयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.29
items.text: कटूष्णमार्द्रकं हृद्यं विपाके शीतलं लघु दीपनं रुचिदं शोफकफकण्ठामयापहम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.30
items.text: मरिचं पलितं श्यामं कोलं वल्लीजमूषणम् यवनेष्टं वृत्तफलं शाकाङ्गं धर्मपत्तनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.31
items.text: कटुकं च शिरोवृत्तं वीरं कफविरोधि च रूक्षं सर्वहितं कृष्णं सप्तभूख्यं निरूपितम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.32
items.text: मरिचं कटु तिक्तोष्णं लघु श्लेष्मविनाशनम् समीरकृमिहृद्रोगहरं च रुचिकारकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.33
items.text: सितमरिचं तु सिताख्यं सितवल्लीजं च बालकं बहुलम् धवलं चन्द्रकमेतन्मुनिनाम गुणाधिकं च वश्यकरम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.34
items.text: कटूष्णं श्वेतमरिचं विषघ्नं भूतनाशनमवृष्यं दृष्टिरोगघ्नं युक्त्या चैव रसायनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.35
items.text: धान्यकं धान्यजं धान्यं धानेयं धनिकं तथा कुस्तुम्बुरुश्चावलिका छत्त्रधान्यं वितुन्नकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.36
items.text: सुगन्धिः शाकयोग्यश्च सूक्ष्मपत्रो जनप्रियः धान्यबीजो बीजधान्यं वेधकं षोडशाह्वयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.37
items.text: धान्यकं मधुरं शीतं कषायं पित्तनाशनम् ज्वरकासतृषाछर्दिकफहारि च दीपनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.38
items.text: यवानी दीप्यको दीप्यो यवसाह्वो यवाग्रजः दीपनी चोग्रगन्धा च वातारिर्भूकदम्बकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.39
items.text: यवजो दीपनीयश्च शूलहन्त्री यवानिका उग्रा च तीव्रगन्धा च ज्ञेया पञ्चदशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.40
items.text: यवानी कटुतिक्तोष्णा वातार्शःश्लेष्मनाशनी शूलाध्मानक्रिमिच्छर्दिमर्दनी दीपनी परा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.41
items.text: चव्यकं चविका चव्यं वशिरो गन्धनाकुली वल्ली च कोलवल्ली च कोलं कुटलमस्तकम् तीक्ष्णा करिणिका वल्ली कृकरो नेत्रभूह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.42
items.text: चव्यं स्यादुष्णकटुकं लघु रोचनदीपनम् जन्तूद्रेकापहं कासश्वासशूलार्तिकृन्तनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.43
items.text: चित्रको ऽग्निश्च शार्दूलश्चित्रपाली कटुः शिखी कृशानुर्दहनो व्यालो ज्योतिष्कः पालकस्तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.44
items.text: अनलो दारुणो वह्निः पावकः शबलस्तथा पाठी द्वीपी च चित्राङ्गो ज्ञेयः शूरश्च विंशतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.45
items.text: चित्रको ऽग्निसमः पाके कटुः शोफकफापहः वातोदरार्शोग्रहणीक्रिमिकण्डूतिनाशनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.46
items.text: कालो व्यालः कालमूलो ऽतिदीप्यो मार्जारो ऽग्निर्दाहकः पावकश्च चित्राङ्गो ऽयं रक्तचित्रो महाङ्गः स्याद्रुद्राह्वश्चित्रको ऽन्यो गुणाढ्यः

items.title: Pipp.47
items.text: स्थूलकायकरो रुच्यः कुष्ठघ्नो रक्तचित्रकः रसे नियामको लोहे वेधकश्च रसायनः
