items.title: Pipp.48
items.text: विडङ्गा क्रिमिहा चैत्रा तण्डुला तण्डुलीयका वातारिस्तण्डुला प्रोक्ता जन्तुघ्नी मृगगामिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.49
items.text: कैरली गह्वरामोघा कपाली चित्रतण्डुला वरा सुचित्रबीजा च जन्तुहन्त्री च षोडश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.50
items.text: विडङ्गा कटुरुष्णा च लघुर्वातकफार्तिनुत् अग्निमान्द्यारुचिभ्रान्तिक्रिमिदोषविनाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.51
items.text: वचोग्रगन्धा गोलोमी जटिलोग्रा च लोमशा रक्षोघ्नी विजया भद्रा मङ्गल्येति दशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.52
items.text: वचा तीक्ष्णा कटूष्णा च कफामग्रन्थिशोफनुत् वातज्वरातिसारघ्नी वान्तिकृन्मादनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.53
items.text: मेध्या श्वेतवचा त्वन्या षड्ग्रन्था दीर्घपत्त्रिका तीक्ष्णगन्धा हैमवती मङ्गल्या विजया च सा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.54
items.text: श्वेतवचातिगुणाढ्या मतिमेधायुःसमृद्धिदा कफनुत् वृष्या च वातभूतक्रिमिदोषघ्नी च दीपनी च वचा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.55
items.text: कुलञ्जो गन्धमूलश्च तीक्ष्णमूलः कुलञ्जनः कुलञ्जः कटुतिक्तोष्णो दीपनो मुखदोषनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.56
items.text: जीरको जरणो जीरो जीर्णो दीप्यश्च दीपकः अजाजिको वह्निशङ्खो मागधश्च नवाह्वयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.57
items.text: जीरकः कटुरुष्णश्च वातहृद्दीपनः परः गुल्माध्मानातिसारघ्नो ग्रहणीक्रिमिहृत्परः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.58
items.text: गौरादिजीरकस्त्वन्यो ऽजाजी स्यात् श्वेतजीरकः कणाह्वा कणजीर्णा च कणा दीप्यः सितादिकः ज्ञेया दीर्घकणा चैव सिताजाजी दशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.59
items.text: गौराजाजी हिमा रुच्या कटुर्मधुरदीपनी क्रिमिघ्नी विषहन्त्री च चक्षुष्याध्माननाशिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.60
items.text: कृष्णा तु जरणा काली बहुगन्धा च भेदिनी कटुभेदिनिका रुच्या नीला नीलकणा स्मृता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.61
items.text: काश्मीरजीरका वर्षा काली स्याद्दन्तशोधनी कालमेषी सुगन्धा च विज्ञेया बाणभूह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.62
items.text: जरणा कटुरुष्णा च कफशोफनिकृन्तनी रुच्या जीर्णज्वरघ्नी च चक्षुष्या ग्रहणीहरा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.63
items.text: दीप्योपकुञ्चिका काली पृथ्वी स्थूलकणा पृथुः मनोज्ञा जरणी जीर्णा तरुणी स्थूलजीरकः सुषवी कारवी ज्ञेया पृथ्वीका च चतुर्दश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.64
items.text: पृथ्वीका कटुतिक्तोष्णा वातगुल्मामदोषनुत् श्लेष्माध्मानहरा जीर्णा जन्तुघ्नी दीपनी परा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.65
items.text: बृहत्पाली क्षुद्रपत्त्रो ऽरण्यजीरः कणा तथा वनजीरः कटुः शीतो व्रणहा पञ्चनामकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.66
items.text: जीरकाः कटुकाः पाके क्रिमिघ्ना वह्निदीपनाः जीर्णज्वरहरा रुच्या व्रणहाध्माननाशनाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.67
items.text: मेथिका मेथिनी मेथी दीपनी बहुपत्रिका वेधनी गन्धबीजा च ज्योतिर्गन्धफला तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.68
items.text: वल्लरी चन्द्रिका मेथा मिश्रपुष्पा च कैरवी कुञ्चिका बहुपर्णी च पीतबीजा मुनीन्दुधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.69
items.text: मेथिका कटुरुष्णा च रक्तपित्तप्रकोपणी अरोचकहरा दीप्तिकरा वातघ्नदीपनी

items.title: Pipp.70
items.text: पृथ्वीका हिङ्गुपत्त्री च कवरी दीर्घिका पृथुः तन्वी च दारुपत्त्री च बिल्वी बाष्पी नवाह्वया

items.text: हिङ्गुपत्त्री कटुस्तीक्ष्णा तिक्तोष्णा कफवातनुत् आमक्रिमिहरा रुच्या पथ्या दीपनपाचनी

items.title: Pipp.74
items.text: हृद्यं हिङ्गु कटूष्णं च क्रिमिवातकफापहम् विबन्धाध्मानशूलघ्नं चक्षुष्यं गुल्मनाशनम्

items.text: नाडीहिङ्गुः पलाशाख्या जन्तुका रामठी च सा वंशपत्त्री च पिण्डाह्वा सुवीर्या हिङ्गुनाडिका

items.title: Pipp.76
items.text: नाडीहिङ्गुः कटूष्णा च कफवातार्तिशान्तिकृत् विष्ठाविबन्धदोषघ्नमानाहामयहारि च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.77
items.text: अग्निजारो ऽग्निनिर्यासो ऽप्यग्निगर्भो ऽग्निजः स्मृतः वडवाग्निमलो ज्ञेयो जरायुश्चाग्निसम्भवः

items.title: Pipp.78
items.text: स्यादग्निजारः कटुरुष्णवीर्यस्तुण्डामयो वातकफापहश्च पित्तप्रदः सो ऽधिकसंनिपातशूलार्तिशीतामयनाशकश्च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.79
items.text: जाराभो दहनस्पर्शी पिच्छिलः सागरे भवः जरायुस्तच्चतुर्वर्णः तेषु श्रेष्ठः सलोहितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.80
items.text: रास्ना युक्तरसा रम्या श्रेयसी रसना रसा सुगन्धिमूला सुरसा रसाढ्यातिरसा दश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.81
items.text: रास्ना तु त्रिविधा प्रोक्ता पत्रं तृणं तथा ज्ञेये दले श्रेष्ठे तृणरास्ना च मध्यमा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.82
items.text: रास्ना गुरुश्च तिक्तोष्णा विषवातास्रकासजित् शोफकम्पोदरश्लेष्मशमनी पाचनी च सा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.83
items.text: स्थूलैला बृहदेला त्रिपुटा त्रिदिवोद्भवा च भद्रैला सुरभित्वक्च महैला पृथ्वी कन्या कुमारिका चैन्द्री
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.84
items.text: कायस्था गोपुटा कान्ता घृताची गर्भसम्भवा इन्द्राणी दिव्यगन्धा च विज्ञेयाष्टादशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.85
items.text: एला बहुलगन्धैन्द्री द्राविडी निष्कुटिस्त्रुटिः कपोतवर्णी गौराङ्गी बाला बलवती हिमा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.86
items.text: चन्द्रिका चोपकुञ्ची च सूक्ष्मा सागरगामिनी गर्भारिर्गन्धफलिका कायस्थाष्टादशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.87
items.text: एलाद्वयं शीतलतिक्तमुक्तं सुगन्धि पित्तार्तिकफापहारि करोति हृद्रोगमलार्तिवस्तिशूलघ्नमत्र स्थविरा गुणाढ्या
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.88
items.text: सैन्धवं स्याच्छीतशिवं नादेयं सिन्धुजं शिवम् शुद्धं शिवात्मजं पथ्यं मणिमन्थं नवाभिधम्

items.title: Pipp.89
items.text: सैन्धवं लवणं वृष्यं चक्षुष्यं रुचिदीपनम् त्रिदोषशमनं पूतं व्रणदोषविबन्धजित्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.90
items.text: सैन्धवं द्विविधं ज्ञेयं श्वेतं रक्तमिति क्रमात् रसवीर्यविपाकेषु गुणाढ्यं नूतनं शिवम्

items.title: Pipp.91
items.text: सौवर्चलं तु रुचकं तिलकं हृद्यगन्धकमक्षं च कृष्णलवणं रुच्यं कौद्रविकं तथा

items.title: Pipp.92
items.text: सौवर्चलं लघु क्षारं कटूष्णं गुल्मजन्तुजित् ऊर्ध्ववातामशूलार्तिविबन्धारोचकान्जयेत्

items.title: Pipp.93
items.text: नीलं काचोद्भवं काचं तिलकं काचसम्भवम् काचसौवर्चलं कृष्णलवणं पाक्यजं स्मृतम्

items.title: Pipp.94
items.text: काचोत्थं हृद्यगन्धं च तत्काललवणं तथा कुरुविन्दं काचमलं कृत्रिमं च चतुर्दश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.95
items.text: काचादिलवणं रुच्यमीषत्क्षारं च पित्तलम् दाहकं कफवातघ्नं दीपनं गुल्मशूलहृत्

items.title: Pipp.96
items.text: विडं द्राविडकं खण्डं कृतकं क्षारमासुरम् सुपाक्यं खण्डलवणं धूर्तं कृत्रिमकं दश

items.title: Pipp.97
items.text: विडमुष्णं च लवणं दीपनं वातनाशनम् रुच्यं चाजीर्णशूलघ्नं गुल्ममेहविनाशनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.98
items.text: गाढादिलवणं शुभ्रं पृथ्वीजं गडदेशजम् गडोत्थं च महारम्भं साम्भरं सम्भरोद्भवम्

items.title: Pipp.99
items.text: गडोत्थं तूष्णलवणमीषदम्लं मलापहम् दीपनं कफवातघ्नमर्शोघ्नं कोष्ठशोधनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.100
items.text: सामुद्रकं तु सामुद्रं समुद्रलवणं शिवम् वंशिरं सागरोत्थं च शिशिरं लवणाब्धिजम्

items.title: Pipp.102

items.text: द्रौणेयं लवणं पाके नात्युष्णमविदाहि च भेदनं स्निग्धमीषच्च शूलघ्नं चाल्पपित्तलम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.104
items.text: औषरकं सार्वगुणं सार्वरसं सर्वलवणमूषरजम् साम्भारं बहुलवणं मेलकलवणं च मिश्रकं नवधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.105
items.text: औषरं तु कटु क्षारं तिक्तं वातकफापहम् विदाहि पित्तकृद्ग्राहि मूत्रसंशोषकारि च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.106
items.text: रोमकमौद्भिदमुक्तं वसुकं वसु पांशुलवणमूषरजम् पांशवमौषरमैरिणमौर्वं सार्वसहं रुद्रैः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.107
items.text: रोमकं तीक्ष्णमत्युष्णं कटु तिक्तं च दीपनम् दाहशोषकरं ग्राहि पित्तकोपकरं परम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.108
items.text: अजमोदा खराह्वा च बस्तमोदा च मर्कटी मोदा गन्धदला हस्तिकारवी गन्धपत्त्रिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.109
items.text: मायूरी शिखिमोदा च मोदाढ्या वह्निदीपिका ब्रह्मकोशी विशाली च हृद्यगन्धोग्रगन्धिका मोदिनी फलमुख्या च वसुचन्द्राभिधा मता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.110
items.text: अजमोदा कटुरुष्णा रूक्षा कफवातहारिणी रुचिकृत् शूलाध्मानारोचकजठरामयनाशनी चैव
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.111
items.text: रेणुका कपिला कान्ता नन्दिनी महिला द्विजा राजपुत्री हिमा रेणुः पाण्डुपत्त्री हरेणुका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.112
items.text: सुपर्णी शिशिरा शान्ता कौन्ती वृत्ता च धर्मिणी कपिलोमा हैमवती पाण्डुपत्त्री च विंशतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.113
items.text: रेणुका तु कटुः शीता खर्जूकण्डूतिहारिणी तृष्णादाहविषघ्नी च मुखवैमल्यकारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.114
items.text: बोलं रक्तापहं मुण्डं सुरसं पिण्डकं विषम् निर्लोहं बर्बरं पिण्डं सौरभं रक्तगन्धकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.115
items.text: रसगन्धं महागन्धं विश्वं च शुभगन्धकम् विश्वगन्धं गन्धरसं व्रणारिर्वसुभूह्वयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.116
items.text: बोलं तु कटुतिक्तोष्णं कषायं रक्तदोषनुत्कफपित्तामयान्हन्ति प्रदरादिरुजापहम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.117
items.text: कर्चूरो द्राविडः कार्शो दुर्लभो गन्धमूलकः वेधमुख्यो गन्धसारो जटिलश्चाष्टनामकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.118
items.text: कर्चूरः कटुतिक्तोष्णः कफकासविनाशनः मुखवैशद्यजननो गलगण्डादिदोषनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.119

items.title: Pipp.120
items.text: एकाष्ठीला कुचैली च दीपनी वरतिक्तका तिक्तपुष्पा बृहत्तिक्ता दीपनी त्रिशिरा वृकी मालवी च वरा देवी वृत्तपर्णी द्विदृङ्मिता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.122
items.text: वृक्षाम्लमम्लशाकं स्याच्चुक्राम्लं तित्तिडीफलम् शाकाम्लमम्लपूरं च पूराम्लं रक्तपूरकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.123
items.text: चूडाम्लबीजाम्लफलाम्लकं स्यादम्लादिवृक्षाम्लफलं रसाम्लम् श्रेष्ठाम्लमत्यम्लमथाम्लबीजं फलं च चुक्रादि नगेन्दुसंख्यम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: वृक्षाम्लमम्लं कटुकं कषायं सोष्णं कफार्शोघ्नमुदीरयन्ति तृष्णासमीरोदरहृद्गदादिगुल्मातीसारव्रणदोषनाशि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.125
items.text: अम्लो ऽम्लवेतसो वेधी रसाम्लो वीरवेतसः वेतसाम्लश्चाम्लसारः शतवेधी च वेधकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.126
items.text: भीमश्च भेदनो भेदी राजाम्लश्चाम्लभेदनः अम्लाङ्कुशो रक्तसारः फलाम्लश्चाम्लनायकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.127
items.text: सहस्रवेधी वीराम्लो गुल्मकेतुर्धराक्षिधा शङ्खमांसादिद्रावी स्याद्द्विधा चैवाम्लवेतसः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.128
items.text: अम्लवेतसमत्यम्लं कषायोष्णं च वातजित्कफार्शःश्रमगुल्मघ्नमरोचकहरं परम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.129
items.text: कटुका जननी तिक्ता रोहिणी तिक्तरोहिणी चक्राङ्गी मत्स्यपित्ता च बकुला शुकुलादनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.130
items.text: सादनी शतपर्वा स्यात् चक्राङ्गी मत्स्यभेदिनी अशोकरोहिणी कृष्णा कृष्णमेदा महौषधी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.131
items.text: कट्व्यञ्जनी काण्डरुहा कटुश्च कटुरोहिणी केदारकटुकारिष्टाप्यामघ्नी पञ्चविंशतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.132
items.text: कटुकातिकटुस्तिक्ता शीतपित्तास्रदोषजित् बलासारोचकश्वासज्वरहृद्रेचनी च सा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.133
items.text: अतिविषा श्वेतकन्दा विश्वा शृङ्गी च भङ्गुरा विरूपा श्यामकन्दा च विश्वरूपा महौषधी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.134
items.text: वीरा प्रतिविषा चान्द्री विषा श्वेतवचा स्मृता अरुणोपविषा चैव ज्ञेया षोडशसंमिता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.135
items.text: कटूष्णातिविषा तिक्ता कफपित्तज्वरापहा आमातीसारकासघ्नी विषच्छर्दिविनाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.136
items.text: त्रिविधातिविषा ज्ञेया शुक्ला कृष्णा तथारुणा रसवीर्यविपाकेषु निर्विशेषगुणा च सा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.137
items.text: दोलायां गोमयक्वाथे पचेदतिविषां ततः सूर्यतापे भवेच् छुष्का योजयेत्तां भिषग्वरः

items.title: Pipp.138
items.text: मुस्ताभद्रावारिदाम्भोदमेघा जीमूतो ऽब्दो नीरदो ऽब्भ्रं घनश्च गाङ्गेयं स्याद्भद्रमुस्ता वराही गुञ्जा ग्रन्थिर्भद्रकासी कसेरुः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.139
items.text: क्रोडेष्टा कुरुविन्दाख्या सुगन्धिर्ग्रन्थिला हिमा वन्या राजकसेरुश्च कच्छोत्था पञ्चविंशतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.140
items.text: भद्रमुस्ता कषाया च तिक्ता शीता च पाचनी पित्तज्वरकफघ्नी च ज्ञेया संग्रहणी च सा

items.title: Pipp.141
items.text: अपरा नागरमुस्ता नागरोत्था नागरादिघनसंज्ञा चक्राङ्का नादेयी चूडाला पिण्डमुस्ता च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.142
items.text: शिशिरा च वृषध्वाङ्क्षी कच्छरुहा चारुकेसरोच्चटा सा पूर्णकोष्ठसंज्ञा कलापिनी सागरेन्दुमिता
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.143
items.text: तिक्ता नागरमुस्ता कटुः कषाया च शीतला कफनुत्पित्तज्वरातिसारारुचितृष्णादाहनाशनी श्रमहृत्

items.title: Pipp.144
items.text: यष्टीमधुर्मधुयष्टी मधुवल्ली मधुस्रवा मधुकं मधुका यष्टी यष्ट्याह्वं वसुसंमितम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.145
items.text: मधुरं यष्टिमधुकं किंचित्तिक्तं च शीतलम् चक्षुष्यं पित्तहृद्रुच्यं शोषतृष्णाव्रणापहम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.146
items.text: अन्यत्क्लीतनमुक्तं क्लीतनकं क्लीतनीयकं मधुकम् मधुवल्ली च मधूली मधुरलता मधुरसातिरसा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.147
items.text: शोषापहा च सौम्या स्थलजा जलजा च सा द्विधाभूता सामान्येन मतेयमेकादशसंज्ञा बहुज्ञधिया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.148
items.text: क्लीतनं मधुरं रुच्यं बल्यं वृष्यं व्रणापहम् शीतलं गुरु चक्षुष्यमस्रपित्तापहं परम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.149
items.text: भार्ङ्गी गर्दभिशाकश्च फञ्जी चाङ्गारवल्लरी वर्षा ब्राह्मणयष्टिश्च बर्बरो भृङ्गजा च सा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.150
items.text: पद्मा यष्टिश्च भारङ्गी वातारिः कासजित्परम् सुरूपा भ्रमरेष्टा च शक्रमाता च षोडश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.151
items.text: भार्ङ्गी तु कटुतिक्तोष्णा कासश्वासविनाशनी शोफव्रणक्रिमिघ्नी च दाहज्वरनिवारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.152
items.text: मूलं पुष्करमूलं च पुष्करं पद्मपत्त्रकम् पद्मं पुष्करजं बीजं पौष्करं पुष्कराह्वयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.153
items.text: काश्मीरं ब्रह्मतीर्थं च श्वासारिर्मूलपुष्करम् ज्ञेयं पञ्चदशाह्वं च पुष्कराद्ये जटाशिफे
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.154
items.text: पुष्करं कटुतिक्तोष्णं कफवातज्वरापहम् श्वासारोचककासघ्नं शोफघ्नं पाण्डुनाशनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.155
items.text: शृङ्गी कुलीरशृङ्गी स्यात् घोषा च वनमूर्धजा चन्द्रा कर्कटशृङ्गी च महाघोषा च शृङ्गिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.156
items.text: कालिका चेन्दुखण्डा च लताङ्गी च विषाणिका चक्रा च शिखरं चैव कर्कटाह्वा त्रिपञ्चधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.157
items.text: तिक्ता कर्कटशृङ्गी तु गुरुरुष्णानिलापहा हिक्कातीसारकासघ्नी श्वासपित्तास्रनाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.158
items.text: दन्ती शीघ्रा श्येनघण्टा निकुम्भी नागस्फोता दन्तिनी चोपचित्रा भद्रा रूक्षा रोचनी चानुकूला निःशल्या स्याद्वक्रदन्ता विशल्या
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.159
items.text: मधुपुष्पैरण्डफला भद्राण्येरण्डपत्त्रिका उदुम्बरदला चैव तरुणी चाणुरेवती विशोधनी च कुम्भी च ज्ञेया चाग्निकराह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.160
items.text: दन्ती कटूष्णा शूलामत्वग्दोषशमनी च सा अर्शोव्रणाश्मरीशल्यशोधनी दीपनी परा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.161
items.text: अन्या दन्ती केशरुहा विषभद्रा जयावहा आवर्तकी वराङ्गी च जयाह्वा भद्रदन्तिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.162
items.text: अन्या दन्ती कटूष्णा च रेचनी क्रिमिहा परा शूलकुष्ठामदोषघ्नी त्वगामयविनाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.163
items.text: रेचको जयपालश्च सारकस्तित्तिरीफलम् दन्तीबीजं मलद्रावि ज्ञेयं स्याद्बीजरेचनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.164
items.text: कुम्भीबीजं कुम्भिनीबीजसंज्ञं घण्टाबीजं दन्तिनीबीजमुक्तम् बीजान्ताख्यं शोधनी चक्रदन्त्यो वेदेन्द्वाख्यं तन्निकुम्भ्याश्च बीजम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.165
items.text: जैपालः कटुरुष्णश्च क्रिमिहारी विरेचनः दीपनः कफवातघ्नो जठरामयशोधनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.166
items.text: उक्ता त्रिवृन्मालविका मसूरा श्यामार्धचन्द्रा विदला सुषेणी कालिन्दिका सैव तु कालमेषी काली त्रिवेलावनिचन्द्रसंज्ञा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.167
items.text: त्रिवृत्तिक्ता कटूष्णा च क्रिमिश्लेष्मोदरार्तिजित्कुष्ठकण्डूव्रणान्हन्ति प्रशस्ता च विरेचने
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.168
items.text: रक्तान्यापि च कालिन्दी त्रिपुटा ताम्रपुष्पिका कुलवर्णा मसूरी चाप्यमृता काकनासिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.169
items.text: रक्ता त्रिवृद्रसे तिक्ता कटूष्णा रेचनी च सा ग्रहणीमलविष्टम्भहारिणी हितकारिणी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.170
items.text: त्वचं त्वग्वल्कलं भृङ्गं वराङ्गं मुखशोधनम् शकलं सैंहलं वन्यं सुरसं रामवल्लभम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.171
items.text: उत्कटं बहुगन्धं च विज्जुलं च वनप्रियम् लाटपर्णं गन्धवल्कं वरं शीतं ग्रहक्षिती
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.172
items.text: त्वचं तु कटुकं शीतं कफकासविनाशनम् शुक्रामशमनं चैव कण्ठशुद्धिकरं लघु
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.173
items.text: पत्रं तमालपत्त्रं च पत्रकं छदनं दलम् पलाशमंशुकं वासस्तापसं सुकुमारकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.174
items.text: वस्त्रं तमालकं रामं गोपनं वसनं तथा तमालं सुरभिगन्धं ज्ञेयं सप्तदशाह्वयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.175
items.text: पत्रकं लघु तिक्तोष्णं कफवातविषापहम् वस्तिकण्डूतिदोषघ्नं मुखमस्तकशोधनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.176
items.text: किञ्जल्कं कनकाह्वं च केसरं नागकेशरम् चाम्पेयं नागकिञ्जल्कं नागीयं काञ्चनं तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.177
items.text: सुवर्णं हेमकिञ्जल्कं रुक्मं हेमं च पिञ्जरम् फणिपुन्नागयोगादि केसरं पञ्चभूह्वयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.178
items.text: नागकेशरमल्पोष्णं लघु तिक्तं कफापहम् वस्तिवातामयघ्नं च कण्ठशीर्षरुजापहम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.179
items.text: तवक्षीरं पयःक्षीरं यवजं गवयोद्भवमन्यद्गोधूमजं चान्यत्पिष्टिकातण्डुलोद्भवम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.180
items.text: अन्यच्च तालसम्भूतं तालक्षीरादिनामकम् वनगोक्षीरजं श्रेष्ठमभावे ऽन्यदुदीरितम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.181
items.text: तवक्षीरं तु मधुरं शिशिरं दाहपित्तनुत्क्षयकासकफश्वासनाशनं चास्रदोषनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.182
items.text: तालीसपत्रं तालीशं पत्त्राख्यं च शुकोदरम् धात्रीपत्त्रं चार्कवेधं करिपत्त्रं घनच्छदम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.183
items.text: नीलं नीलाम्बरं तालं तालीपत्त्रं तलाह्वयम् तालीसपत्त्रकस्येति नामान्याहुस्त्रयोदश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.184
items.text: तालीसपत्रं तिक्तोष्णं मधुरं कफवातनुत्कासहिक्काक्षयश्वासच्छर्दिदोषविनाशकृत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.185
items.text: स्याद्वंशरोचना वांशी तुङ्गक्षीरी तुगा शुभा त्वक्क्षीरी वंशगा शुक्रा वंशक्षीरी च वैणवी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.186
items.text: त्वक्सारा कर्मरी श्वेतावंशकर्पूररोचने तुङ्गा रोचनिका पिङ्गा नवेन्दुर्वंशशर्करा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.187
items.text: स्याद्वंशरोचना रूक्षा कषाया मधुरा हिमा रक्तशुद्धिकरी तापपित्तोद्रेकहरा शुभा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.188
items.text: तवक्षीरे यवक्षीरे क्षीरे जातं गुणोत्तरम् वंशक्षीरीसमं प्रोक्तं तदभावे ऽन्यवस्तुजम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.189
items.text: गवयक्षीरजं क्षीरं सुस्निग्धं शीतलं लघु सुगन्धि द्रावकं शुभ्रमन्यत्स्वल्पगुणं स्मृतम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.190
items.text: मञ्जिष्ठा हरिणी रक्ता गौरी योजनवल्लिका समङ्गा विकसा पद्मा रोहिणी कालमेषिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.191
items.text: भण्डी चित्रलता चित्रा चित्राङ्गी जननी च सा मण्डूकपर्णी विजया मञ्जूषा रक्तयष्टिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.192
items.text: क्षेत्रिणी चैव रागाढ्या भण्डीरी कालभाण्डिका अरुणा ज्वरहन्त्री च छद्मा नागकुमारिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.193
items.text: भाण्डीरलतिका चैव रागाङ्गी वस्त्रभूषणा त्रिंशाह्वया तथा प्रोक्ता मञ्जिष्ठा च भिषग्वरैः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.194
items.text: मञ्जिष्ठा मधुरा स्वादे कषायोष्णा गुरुस्तथा व्रणमेहज्वरश्लेष्मविषनेत्रामयापहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.195
items.text: चोलश्च योजनी कौञ्जी सिंहिली च चतुर्विधा मञ्जिष्ठा चैव सा प्रोक्ता विलोमे चोत्तमोत्तमा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.196
items.text: हरिद्रा हरिद्रञ्जनी स्वर्णवर्णा सुवर्णा शिवा वर्णिनी दीर्घरागा हरिद्री च पीता वराङ्गी च गौरी जनिष्ठा वरा वर्णदात्री पवित्रा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.197
items.text: हरिता रजनीनाम्नी विषघ्नी वरवर्णिनी पिङ्गला वर्णदा चैव मङ्गल्या मङ्गला च सा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.198
items.text: लक्ष्मी भद्रा शिफा शोफा शोभना सुभगाह्वया श्यामा जयन्तिका द्वे च त्रिंशन्नामविलासिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.199
items.text: हरिद्रा कटुतिक्तोष्णा कफवातास्रकुष्ठनुत् मेहकण्डूव्रणान्हन्ति देहवर्णविधायिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.200
items.text: अन्या दारुहरिद्रा च दार्वी पीतद्रु पीतिका कालेयकं पीतदारु स्थिररागा च कामिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.201
items.text: कटङ्कटेरी पर्जन्या पीता दारुनिशा स्मृता कालीयकं कामवती दारुपीता पचम्पचा स्यात्कर्कटकिनी ज्ञेया प्रोक्ता सप्तदशाह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.202
items.text: तिक्ता दारुहरिद्रा तु कटूष्णा व्रणमेहनुत्कण्डूविसर्पत्वग्दोषविषकर्णाक्षिदोषहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.203
items.text: लाक्षा खदिरका रक्ता रङ्गमाता पलङ्कषा जतु च क्रिमिजा चैव द्रुमव्याधिरलक्तकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.204
items.text: पलाशी मुद्रणी दीप्तिर्जन्तुका गन्धमादनी नीला द्रवरसा चैव पित्तारिर्मुनिभूह्वया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.205
items.text: लाक्षा तिक्तकषाया स्यात् श्लेष्मपित्तार्तिदोषनुत् विषरक्तप्रशमनी विषमज्वरनाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.206
items.text: अलक्तको जन्तुरसो रागो निर्भर्त्सनस्तथा जननी जन्तुकारी च संधर्षा चक्रमर्दिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.207
items.text: अलक्तकः सुतिक्तोष्णः कफवातामयापहः कण्ठरुक्शमनो रुच्यो व्रणदोषार्तिनाशनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.208
items.text: लोध्रो रोध्रो भिल्लतरुश्चिल्लकः काण्डकीलकः तिरीटो लोध्रको वृक्षः शम्बरो हस्तिरोध्रकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.209
items.text: तिल्वकः काण्डहीनश्च शावरो हेमपुष्पकः भिल्ली शावरकश्चैव ज्ञेयः पञ्चदशाह्वयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.210
items.text: क्रमुकः पट्टिकारोध्रो वल्करोध्रो बृहद्दलः जीर्णबुध्नो बृहद्वल्को जीर्णपत्त्रो ऽक्षिभेषजः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.211
items.text: शावरः श्वेतरोध्रश्च मार्जनो बहलत्वचः पट्टी लाक्षाप्रसादश्च वल्कलो बाणभूह्वयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.212
items.text: लोध्रद्वयं कषायं स्यात् शीतं वातकफास्रनुत् चक्षुष्यं विषहृत्तत्र विशिष्टो वल्करोध्रकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.213
items.text: धातकी वह्निपुष्पी च ताम्रपुष्पी च धावनी अग्निज्वाला सुभिक्षा च पार्वती बहुपुष्पिका

items.title: Pipp.214

items.title: Pipp.261
items.text: साफल्याय किलैत्य यानि जनुषः कान्तारदूरान्तरात्स्वौजःपात्रविचारणाय विपणेर्मध्यं समध्यासते तेषामाश्रयभूमिरेष भणितः पण्यौषधीनां बुधैर्वर्गो द्रव्यगुणाभिधाननिपुणैः पण्यादिवर्गात्मना
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Pipp.262
items.text: यः सौम्येन सदाशयेन कलयन्दिव्यागमानां जनैर्दुर्ग्राहं महिमानमाशु नुदते स्वं जग्मुषां दुर्गतीः वर्गः पिप्पलिकादिरेष नृहरेस्तस्येह शस्यात्मनो नामग्रामशिखामणौ खलु कृतौ षष्ठः प्रतिष्ठामगात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.1
items.text: प्रभद्रः पञ्चधा प्रोक्तः काश्मर्यो लघुपूर्वकः द्विरग्निमन्थः श्योनाकद्वितयं चाजशृङ्गिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.2
items.text: काश्मर्याश्मन्तकश्चाथ कर्णिकारद्वयं तथा वृश्चिकाली च कुटजस्तद्बीजं च शिरीषकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.3
items.text: करञ्जः षड्विधो ऽङ्कोलो नीलः सर्जाश्वकर्णकौ तालः श्रीतालहिन्तालमाडास्तूलस्तमालकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.4
items.text: चतुर्विधः कदम्बो ऽथ वानीरः कुम्भिवेतसः धवश्च धन्वनो भूर्जस्तिनिशश्च ततो ऽर्जुनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.5
items.text: हरिद्रुदग्धाशाखोटाः शाको ऽथो शिंशपात्रयमसनत्रयं च वरुणः पुत्रजीवश्च पिण्डिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.6
items.text: कारस्करो ऽथ कटभ्यौ क्षवको देवसर्षपः डहुर्विकङ्कतश्चेति स्वराब्धिगणिताः क्रमात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.7
items.text: अथ निगदितः प्रभद्रः पिचुमन्दः पारिभद्रको निम्बः काकफलः कीरेष्टो नेतारिष्टश्च सर्वतोभद्रः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.8
items.text: धमनो विशीर्णपर्णः पवनेष्टः पीतसारकः शीतः वरतिक्तो ऽरिष्टफलो ज्येष्ठामालकश्च हिङ्गुनिर्यासः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.9
items.text: छर्दनश्चाग्निधमनो ज्ञेया नाम्नां तु विंशतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.10
items.text: प्रभद्रकः प्रभवति शीततिक्तकः कफव्रणकृमिवमिशोफशान्तये बलासभिद्बहुविषपित्तदोषजिद्विशेषतो हृदयविदाहशान्तिकृत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.11
items.text: महानिम्बो मदोद्रेकः कार्मुकः केशमुष्टिकः काकाण्डो रम्यको ऽक्षीरो महातिक्तो हिमद्रुमः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.12
items.text: महानिम्बस्तु शिशिरः कषायः कटुतिक्तकः अस्रदाहबलासघ्नो विषमज्वरनाशनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.13
items.text: कैडर्यो ऽन्यो महानिम्बो रामणो रमणस्तथा गिरिनिम्बो महारिष्टः शुक्लशालः कफाह्वयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.14
items.text: कैडर्यः कटुकस्तिक्तः कषायः शीतलो लघुः संतापशोषकुष्ठास्रकृमिभूतविषापहः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.15
items.text: भूनिम्बो नार्यतिक्तः स्यात्कैरातो रामसेनकः कैराततिक्तको हैमः काण्डतिक्तः किरातकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.16
items.text: भूनिम्बो वातलस्तिक्तः कफपित्तज्वरापहः व्रणसंरोपणः पथ्यः कुष्ठकण्डूतिशोफनुत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.17
items.text: नेपालनिम्बो नैपालस्तृणनिम्बो ज्वरान्तकः नाडीतिक्तो ऽर्धतिक्तश्च निद्रारिः संनिपातहा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.18
items.text: नेपालनिम्बः शीतोष्णो योगवाही लघुस्तथा तिक्तो ऽतिकफपित्तास्रशोफतृष्णाज्वरापहः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.19
items.text: कण्डूलः कृष्णगर्भश्च सोमवल्कप्रचेतसी भद्रावती महाकुम्भी कैडर्यो रामसेनकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.20
items.text: कुमुदा चोग्रगन्धश्च भद्रा रञ्जनकस्तथा कुम्भी च लघुकाश्मर्यः श्रीपर्णी च त्रिपञ्चधा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.21
items.text: कट्फलः कटुरुष्णश्च कासश्वासज्वरापहः उग्रदाहहरो रुच्यो मुखरोगशमप्रदः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.22
items.text: अग्निमन्थो ऽग्निमथनः तर्कारी वैजयन्तिका वह्निमन्थो ऽरणी केतुः श्रीपर्णी कर्णिका जया नादेयी विजयानन्ता नदी यावत्त्रयोदश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.23
items.text: तर्कारी कटुरुष्णा च तिक्तानिलकफापहा शोफश्लेष्माग्निमान्द्यार्शोविड्बन्धाध्माननाशनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.24
items.text: क्षुद्राग्निमन्थस्तपनो विजया गणिकारिका अरणिर्लघुमन्थश्च तेजोवृक्षस्तनुत्वचा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.25
items.text: अग्निमन्थद्वयं चैव तुल्यं वीर्यरसादिषु तत्प्रयोगानुसारेण योजयेत्स्वमनीषया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.26
items.text: श्योनाकः शुकनासश्च कट्वङ्गो ऽथ कटंभरः मयूरजङ्घो ऽरलुकः प्रियजीवः कुटन्नटः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.27
items.text: श्योनाकः पृथुशिम्बो ऽन्यो भल्लको दीर्घवृन्तकः पोतवृक्षश्च टेण्टूको भूतसारो मुनिद्रुमः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.28
items.text: निःसारः फल्गुवृन्ताकः पूतिपत्त्रो वसन्तकः मण्डूकपर्णः पीताङ्गो जम्बूकः पीतपादकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.29
items.text: वातारिः पीतकः शोणः कुटनश्च विरेचनः भ्रमरेष्टो बर्हिजङ्घो नेत्रनेत्रमिताभिधः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.30
items.text: श्योनाकयुगलं तिक्तं शीतलं च त्रिदोषजित्पित्तश्लेष्मातिसारघ्नं संनिपातज्वरापहम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.31
items.text: टेण्टुफलं कटूष्णं च कफवातहरं लघु दीपनं पाचनं हृद्यं रुचिकृल्लवणाम्लकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.32
items.text: अजशृङ्गी मेषशृङ्गी वर्तिका सर्पदंष्ट्रिका चक्षुष्या तिक्तदुग्धा च पुत्रश्रेणी विषाणिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.33
items.text: अजशृङ्गी कटुस्तिक्ता कफार्शःशूलशोफजित् चक्षुष्या श्वासहृद्रोगविषकासातिकुष्ठजित्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.34
items.text: अजशृङ्गीफलं तिक्तं कटूष्णं कफवातजित् जठरानलकृत् हृद्यं रुचिरं लवणाम्लकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.35
items.text: स्यात्काश्मर्यः काश्मरी कृष्णवृन्ता हीरा भद्रा सर्वतोभद्रिका च श्रीपर्णी स्यात्सिन्धुपर्णी सुभद्रा कम्भारी सा कट्फला भद्रपर्णी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.36
items.text: कुमुदा च गोपभद्रा विदारिणी क्षीरिणी महाभद्रा मधुपर्णी स्वभद्रा कृष्णा श्वेता च रोहिणी गृष्टिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.37
items.text: स्थूलत्वचा मधुमती सुफला मेदिनी महाकुमुदा सुदृढत्वचा च कथिता विज्ञेयोनत्रिंशतिर्नाम्नाम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.38
items.text: काश्मरी कटुका तिक्ता गुरूष्णा कफशोफनुत्त्रिदोषविषदाहार्तिज्वरतृष्णास्रदोषजित्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.39
items.text: अश्मन्तकश्चेन्दुकश्च कुद्दालश्चाम्लपत्त्रकः श्लक्ष्णत्वक्पीलुपत्त्रश्च स्मृतो यमलपत्त्रकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.40
items.text: अश्मान्तकेन्दुशफरी शिलान्तश्चाम्बुदः स्मृतः पाषाणान्तक इत्युक्तो वह्निचन्द्रमिताह्वयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.41
items.text: अश्मन्तकः स्यान्मधुरः कषायः सुशीतलः पित्तहरः प्रमेहजित् विदाहतृष्णाविषमज्वरापहो विषार्तिविच्छर्दिहरश्च भूतजित्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.42
items.text: अथ भवति कर्णिकारो राजतरुः प्रग्रहश्च कृतमालः सुफलश्च परिव्याधो व्याधिरिपुः पङ्क्तिबीजको वसुसंज्ञः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.43
items.text: कर्णिकारो रसे तिक्तः कटूष्णः कफशूलहृत् उदरकृमिमेहघ्नो व्रणगुल्मनिवारणः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.44
items.text: आरग्वधो ऽन्यो मन्थानो रोचनश्चतुरङ्गुलः आरेवतो दीर्घफलो व्याधिघातो नृपद्रुमः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.45

items.title: Prabh.51
items.text: वृश्चिकाली कटुस्तिक्ता सोष्णा हृद्वक्त्रशुद्धिकृत् रक्तपित्तहरा बल्या विबन्धारोचकापहा

items.title: Prabh.52

items.title: Prabh.54
items.text: कुटजः कटुतिक्तोष्णः कषायश्चातिसारजित्तत्रासितो ऽस्रपित्तघ्नस्त्वग्दोषार्शोनिकृन्तनः

items.title: Prabh.55
items.text: इन्द्रयवा तु शक्राह्वा शक्रबीजानि वत्सकः तथा वत्सकबीजानि भद्रजा कुटजाफलम्

items.title: Prabh.56
items.text: ज्ञेया भद्रयवा चैव बीजान्ता कुटजाभिधा तथा कलिङ्गबीजानि पर्यायैर्दशधाभिधा

items.text: इन्द्रयवा कटुस्तिक्ता शीता कफवातरक्तपित्तहरा दाहातिसारशमनो नानाज्वरदोषशूलमूलघ्नी

items.title: Prabh.58
items.text: शिरीषः शीतपुष्पश्च भण्डिको मृदुपुष्पकः शुकेष्टो बर्हिपुष्पश्च विषहन्ता सुपुष्पकः

items.title: Prabh.60
items.text: शिरीषः कटुकः शीतो विषवातहरः परः पामासृक्कुष्ठकण्डूतित्वग्दोषस्य विनाशनः

items.title: Prabh.62
items.text: करञ्जः कटुरुष्णश्च चक्षुष्यो वातनाशनः तस्य स्नेहो ऽतिस्निग्धश्च वातघ्नः स्थिरदीप्तिदः

items.title: Prabh.63
items.text: अन्यो घृतकरञ्जः स्यात्प्रकीर्यो घृतपर्णकः स्निग्धपत्त्रस्तपस्वी च विषारिश्च विरोचनः

items.title: Prabh.69

items.title: Prabh.75

items.title: Prabh.78

items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.79
items.text: वस्तकर्णः कषायी च ललनो गन्धवृक्षकः वंशश्च शालनिर्यासो दिव्यसारः सुरेष्टकः शूरो ऽग्निवल्लभश्चैव यक्षधूपः सुसिद्धकः

items.title: Prabh.80
items.text: सर्जस्तु कटुतिक्तोष्णो हिमः स्निग्धो ऽतिसारजित्पित्तास्रदोषकुष्ठघ्नः कण्डूविस्फोटवातजित्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.81

items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.82
items.text: अश्वकर्णः कटुस्तिक्तः स्निग्धः पित्तास्रनाशनः ज्वरविस्फोटकण्डूघ्नः शिरोदोषार्तिकृन्तनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.83
items.text: तालस्तालद्रुमः पत्री दीर्घस्कन्धो ध्वजद्रुमः तृणराजो मधुरसो मदाढ्यो दीर्घपादपः

items.title: Prabh.84

items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.85

items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.86

items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.87
items.text: श्रीतालो मधुरो ऽत्यन्तमीषच्चैव कषायकः पित्तजित्कफकारी च वातमीषत्प्रकोपयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.88
items.text: हिन्तालः स्थूलतालश्च वल्कपत्त्रो बृहद्दलः गर्भस्रावी लतातालो भीषणो बहुकण्टकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.89
items.text: स्थिरपत्त्रो द्विधालेख्यः शिरापत्त्रः स्थिराङ्घ्रिपः अम्लसारो बृहत्तालः स्याच्चतुर्दशधाभिधः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.90
items.text: हिन्तालो मधुराम्लश्च कफकृत्पित्तदाहनुत् श्रमतृष्णापहारी च शिशिरो वातदोषनुत्

items.title: Prabh.91
items.text: माडो माडद्रुमो दीर्घो ध्वजवृक्षो वितानकः मद्यद्रुमो मोहकारी मदद्रुरृजुरङ्कधा

items.title: Prabh.92
items.text: माडस्तु शिशिरो रुच्यः कषायः पित्तदाहकृत्तृष्णापहो मरुत्कारी श्रमहृत् श्लेष्मकारकः

items.title: Prabh.93
items.text: तूलं तूदं ब्रह्मकाष्ठं ब्राह्मणेष्टं च यूपकम् ब्रह्मदारु सुपुष्पं च सुरूपं नीलवृन्तकम् क्रमुकं विप्रकाष्ठं च मृदुसारं द्विभूमितम्

items.text: तूलं तु मधुराम्लं स्यात् वातपित्तहरं सरम् दाहप्रशमनं वृष्यं कषायं कफनाशनम्

items.text: तमालो नीलतालः स्यात्कालस्कन्धस्तमालकः नीलध्वजश्च तापिञ्छः कालतालो महाबलः

items.text: तमालो मधुरो बल्यो वृष्यश्च शिशिरो गुरुः कफपित्ततृषादाहश्रमभ्रान्तिकरः परः

items.title: Prabh.97
items.text: कदम्बो वृत्तपुष्पश्च सुरभिर्ललनाप्रियः कादम्बर्यः सिन्धुपुष्पो मदाढ्यः कर्णपूरकः

items.title: Prabh.98
items.text: कदम्बस्तिक्तकटुकः कषायो वातनाशनः शीतलः कफपित्तार्तिनाशनः शुक्रवर्धनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.99
items.text: धाराकदम्बः प्रावृष्यः पुलकी भृङ्गवल्लभः मेघागमप्रियो नीपः प्रावृषेण्यः कदम्बकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.100
items.text: धूलीकदम्बः क्रमुकप्रसूनः परागपुष्पो बलभद्रसंज्ञकः वसन्तपुष्पो मकरन्दवासो भृङ्गप्रियो रेणुकदम्बको ऽष्टौ

items.title: Prabh.101
items.text: भूमीकदम्बो भूनिम्बो भूमिजो भृङ्गवल्लभः लघुपुष्पो वृत्तपुष्पो विषघ्नो व्रणहारकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.102
items.text: त्रिकदम्बाः कटुर्वर्ण्या विषशोफहरा हिमाः कषायाः पित्तलास्तिक्ता वीर्यवृद्धिकराः पराः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.103
items.text: वानीरो वृत्तपुष्पश्च शाखालो जलवेतसः व्याधिघातः परिव्याधो नादेयो जलसम्भवः

items.title: Prabh.104
items.text: वानीरस्तिक्तशिशिरो रक्षोघ्नो व्रणशोधनः पित्तास्रकफदोषघ्नः संग्राही च कषायकः

items.title: Prabh.105
items.text: कुम्भी रोमालुविटपी रोमशः पर्पटद्रुमः कुम्भी कटुः कषायोष्णो ग्राही वातकफापहः

items.title: Prabh.106
items.text: वेतसो निचुलो ज्ञेयो वञ्जुलो दीर्घपत्त्रकः कलनो मञ्जरीनम्रः सुषेणो गन्धपुष्पकः

items.title: Prabh.107
items.text: वेतसः कटुकः स्वादुः शीतो भूतविनाशनः पित्तप्रकोपणो रुच्यो विज्ञेयो दीपनः परः रक्तपित्तोद्भवं रोगं कुष्ठदोषं च नाशयेत्

items.title: Prabh.108
items.text: धवो दृढतरुर्गौरः कषायो मधुरत्वचः शुक्लवृक्षः पाण्डुतरुर्धवलः पाण्डुरो नव

items.title: Prabh.109
items.text: धवः कषायः कटुकः कफघ्नो ऽनिलनाशनः पित्तप्रकोपणो रुच्यो विज्ञेयो दीपनः परः

items.title: Prabh.110
items.text: धन्वनो रक्तकुसुमो धनुवृक्षो महाबलः रुजापहः पिच्छलको रूक्षः स्वादुफलश्च सः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.111
items.text: धन्वनः कटुकोष्णश्च कषायः कफनाशनः दाहशोषकरो ग्राही कण्ठामयशमप्रदः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.112
items.text: भूर्जो वल्कद्रुमो भुर्जः सुचर्मा भूर्जपत्रकः चित्रत्वग्बिन्दुपत्त्रश्च रक्षापत्त्रो विचित्रकः भूतघ्नो मृदुपत्त्रश्च शैलेन्द्रस्थो द्विभूमितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.113
items.text: भूर्जः कटुकषायोष्णो भूतरक्षाकरः परः त्रिदोषशमनः पथ्यो दुष्टकौटिल्यनाशनः

items.title: Prabh.114
items.text: तिनिशः स्यन्दनश्चक्री शताङ्गः शकटो रथः रथिको भस्मगर्भश्च मेषी जलधरो दश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.115
items.text: तिनिशस्तु कषायोष्णः कफरक्तातिसारजित् ग्राहको दाहजननो वातामयहरः परः

items.title: Prabh.116
items.text: अर्जुनः शम्बरः पार्थश्चित्रयोधी धनंजयः वैरान्तकः किरीटी च गाण्डीवी शिवमल्लकः

items.title: Prabh.117
items.text: सव्यसाची नदीसर्जः कर्णारिः कुरुवीरकः कौन्तेय इन्द्रसूनुश्च वीरद्रुः कृष्णसारथिः पृथाजः फाल्गुनो धन्वी ककुभश्चैकविंशतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.118
items.text: अर्जुनस्तु कषायोष्णः कफघ्नो व्रणनाशनः पित्तश्रमतृषार्तिघ्नो मारुतामयकोपनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.title: Prabh.119
items.text: हरिद्रुः पीतदारुः स्यात्पीतकाष्ठश्च पीतकः कदम्बकः सुपुष्पश्च सुराह्वः पीतकद्रुमः

items.title: Prabh.120
items.text: हरिद्रुः शीतलस्तिक्तो मङ्गल्यः पित्तवान्तिजित् अङ्गकान्तिकरो बल्यो नानात्वग्दोषनाशनः
